args.description: Seamless dark marine stone inset panel texture, old smooth slate with faint horizontal shell-limestone veins, dark #14252B #24383D #3D5050. Quiet broad blocks, a clearly lighter material than near-black outer background. Fill edge to edge. No frame or text. Match Dungeon Matcher crisp native pixel-art: no anti-aliasing, gradients, blur or noisy individual speckles. Top-left light.

style_image.usage_description: Pixel density, clean outline and broad shading only; environmental/UI asset described, no character.
